name: pharo-minimal
description: A set of scripts and resources to produce a pharo minimal headless image

paragraphs: This repository contains scripts and patches in order to build a pharo minimal images. The builds are using the VMARCH environment variable to detect which version to build. By using
will build a 32 bit version. Default is to build 64 bit
